description: Read a UK funder's public profile: type, charity or company number, website, register description and income, published 360Giving totals, its open, rolling and forthcoming schemes and its recently closed ones, each with its URL. Look a funder up by OpenGrant slug (from a funderUrl), UK charity number, or name (returns the closest matches if there is more than one).

charity_number.description: Registered charity number (England & Wales, Scotland or Northern Ireland), e.g. '1160879' or 'SC003133'

name.description: Funder name or part of it, e.g. 'Gannochy'

name: get_funder
